'''Baylor Scheierman''' (born September 26, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball|South Dakota State Jackrabbits]] and the [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton Bluejays]].

==High school career==
Scheierman attended [[Aurora High School (Nebraska)|Aurora High School]] and played basketball, football, baseball, and golf. He averaged 16 points, six rebounds, and six assists per game as a junior.<ref name= zimmer/> Scheierman played quarterback and threw for 3,942 yards and a state-record 59 touchdowns as a senior, leading the team to a Class C Championship.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schinzel |first1=Gene |title=Aurora grad Baylor Scheierman is making a big impact for South Dakota State |url=https://omaha.com/sports/college/aurora-grad-baylor-scheierman-is-making-a-big-impact-for-south-dakota-state/article_af83a156-4197-11eb-812e-df1efe56d3fb.html |access-date=March 9, 2022 |work=[[Omaha World-Herald]] |date=December 19, 2020}}</ref> On the court, Scheierman averaged 22.1 points, 9.8 rebounds and 6.5 assists per game as a senior, leading the Huskies to the state tournament.<ref name=zimmer>{{cite news |last1=Zimmer |first1=Matt |title=Baylor Scheierman uses football skills to lead South Dakota State's high-powered hoops offense |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/south-dakota-state-university/2022/01/22/baylor-scheierman-south-dakota-state-jackrabbits-football-skills-basketball-offense-summit-league/6579144001/ |access-date=March 9, 2022 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |date=January 22, 2022}}</ref> In November 2017, he committed to playing college basketball for [[South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball|South Dakota State]], stating he liked the family atmosphere.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sautter |first1=Mike |title=Aurora guard Baylor Scheierman commits to South Dakota State |url=https://omaha.com/sports/high-school/recruiting/aurora-guard-baylor-scheierman-commits-to-south-dakota-state/article_0cd8ef98-c8ef-11e7-8398-6f06e31198fd.html |access-date=March 9, 2022 |work=[[Omaha World-Herald]] |date=November 13, 2017}}</ref>

==College career==
As a freshman, Scheierman averaged six points, 4.7 rebounds, and 2.2 assists per game, shooting 42.7 percent from the floor. He worked on his outside shooting over the summer. On March 8, 2021, he scored a career-high 28 points in a 90–88 semifinals loss against [[Oral Roberts Golden Eagles men's basketball|Oral Roberts]] after [[Kevin Obanor]] made a game-winning shot.<ref>{{cite news |title=Obanor wins it at buzzer, Oral Roberts beats SDSU in Summit |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401287754 |access-date=March 10, 2022 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 8, 2021}}</ref> Scheierman averaged 15.4 points, 9.2 rebounds and four assists per game as a sophomore, shooting 49.8 percent from the floor.<ref name=zimmer/> He was named first-team All-[[Summit League]].<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://thesummitleague.org/news/2021/3/3/awards-oral-roberts-abmas-collects-summitmbb-player-of-the-year-honors.aspx|title=Oral Roberts' Abmas collects #SummitMBB Player of the Year honors|publisher=[[Summit League]] |date=March 4, 2021 |access-date=March 9, 2022}}</ref> He hit a three-pointer at the buzzer in a 77–74 win against [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schinzel |first1=Gene |title=Aurora grad Baylor Scheierman is 'a big part of everything' for South Dakota State |url=https://omaha.com/sports/local/aurora-grad-baylor-scheierman-is-a-big-part-of-everything-for-south-dakota-state/article_2b97e842-73f1-11ec-9358-8f820cd955ad.html |access-date=March 10, 2022 |work=[[Omaha World-Herald]] |date=January 12, 2022}}</ref> Scheierman was named [[Summit League Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Summit League Player of the Year]] as a junior.<ref name=SummitAwards>{{cite press release|url=https://thesummitleague.org/news/2022/3/3/awards-sdsus-scheierman-garners-summitmbb-player-of-the-year-award.aspx|title=SDSU's Scheierman tabbed #SummitMBB Player of the Year|publisher=[[Summit League]] |date=March 3, 2022 |accessdate=March 9, 2022}}</ref> He averaged 16.2 points per game and led the conference in rebounding (7.8 per game) and assists (4.5 per game), shooting 51 percent from the field. Following the season, Scheierman entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]] and also declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] while maintaining his collegiate eligibility.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zimmer |first1=Matt |title=Baylor Scheierman declares for 2022 NBA Draft |url=https://www.argusleader.com/story/sports/college/south-dakota-state-university/2022/03/24/baylor-scheierman-declares-2022-nba-draft/7160503001/ |access-date=March 25, 2022 |work=[[Argus Leader]] |date=March 24, 2022}}</ref> On May 3, 2022, he committed to [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton]] while remaining in the NBA Draft.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tipton |first=Joe |date=May 3, 2022|title=South Dakota St. transfer Baylor Scheierman commits to Creighton|url=https://www.on3.com/news/south-dakota-st-transfer-baylor-scheierman-commits-to-creighton/|access-date=May 3, 2022 |website=On3.com |language=en}}</ref> On May 24, 2022, Scheierman withdrew from the NBA draft.<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 24, 2022|title=Creighton transfer guard Baylor Scheierman withdraws from NBA Draft: Reports|url=https://theathletic.com/news/creighton-transfer-guard-baylor-scheierman-withdraws-from-nba-draft-reports/8A2ZQxIoUxXC/|access-date=May 24, 2022 |work=[[The Athletic]] |language=en}}</ref> He averaged 12.8 points, 8.3 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game as a senior, helping Creighton reach the Elite Eight. Scheierman opted to return for his fifth season of eligibility.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Revia |first1=Nick |title=Baylor Scheierman returning to Creighton for final year of eligibility |url=https://fox42kptm.com/sports/content/baylor-scheierman-returning-to-creighton-for-final-year-of-eligibility |access-date=March 14, 2024 |work=Fox 42 |date=April 13, 2023}}</ref>

Scheierman is a [[Nondenominational Christian]].
